rationale: The Latin anchors *liberare* ("to free/liberate") and *evellere* ("to tear out/away") firmly point to a sense of freeing or rescuing from harm or bondage, which aligns directly with rescue.v.01 ("free from harm or evil"). The theological/heroic context of the Genesis attestation (Cd. 95; Gen. 2048) further supports this liberating sense rather than any sense of delivery or surrender.
